title: AssistantBot
description: A domain-scoped support bot on the Open Agent Continuum (ADR-0001). Each bot maps to an agent-registry AgentSpec principal and answers only in the grounded-answer-card shape.

domain.description: Knowledge scope that grounds this bot (a corpus/registry scope).

skill.description: The grounded skill the bot invokes.

requiredClientFields.description: Client info that MUST be gathered before the bot may answer; a bot answering with any of these missing is rejected.

agentSpecRef.description: agent-registry AgentSpec principal. Enters as an external principal, capped at the Derived epistemic ceiling (STAR-1).
